about: Answer key for the BRF extraction eval. Every value was read from the page text (pdftotext, no -layout) of the sample PDF. page is the PDF page index (1-based). alt_pages are other pages where the same figure is stated; a reply on those pages counts as the right page. keywords are OR-groups for text fields: every group must match one word of the group, case and accent insensitive. unsure marks a field where the report supports more than one reading, so a miss there is a question for the person, not a proof.

sorgarden-2023.description: HSB Brf Sörgården i Göteborg, årsredovisning 2022/2023 (digital PDF, 26 pages). The same report also exists as a scan (scanned/brf-sorgarden-2023-scanned.pdf) and uses this key.

org_nr.note: Cover and report header say org.nr 757200-9087. The auditor report on p19 prints 757200-0987, a typo in the report itself.

year.note: Fiscal year 2022-07-01 to 2023-06-30, reported as 2023. A reader could also say 2022/2023.

debt_per_sqm.note: Skuldsättning 2 103 kr/kvm in the nyckeltal section (p2). Same figure on the cover (p1) and in the flerårsöversikt (p9).

annual_fee_per_sqm.note: Årsavgift 707 kr/kvm in the nyckeltal section (p4). Same figure on the cover (p1) and in the flerårsöversikt (p9).

interest_cost.note: Räntekostnader och liknande resultatposter, 2022-07-01 to 2023-06-30 column (p11). The prior year is -555 255.

planned_maintenance.value: översyn av tak samt byte av fönster inom de närmaste 5 åren
planned_maintenance.note: The plan is stated in words on p8: 'Föreningen följer underhållsplanen. De närmaste 5 åren ligger översyn av tak samt byte av fönster.' No planned amount is stated for it. The 2023 cost line Underhållskostnader -3 828 108 (p11) is not the plan. p2 gives a 50-year investment need of 284 kr/kvm, which some readers would take as the plan figure.

auditor_remarks.note: Clean opinion in the revisionsberättelse: 'Enligt vår uppfattning har årsredovisningen upprättats i enlighet med årsredovisningslagen'. No anmärkning appears on pp19-21.

chalmersgatan-2023.description: Brf Chalmersgatan i Göteborg, årsredovisning 2023 (digital PDF, 25 pages).

org_nr.note: Org.nr 716444-4593 on p2 and every header. Matches the file name.

debt_per_sqm.note: Skuldsättning per kvm upplåten med bostadsrätt, 2023 column of the flerårsöversikt (p8). The same page also gives 6 853 per kvm totalyta. The schema asks for belåning per kvm, which points to the bostadsrätt figure, but the total-area figure is also stated.

annual_fee_per_sqm.note: Årsavgift per kvm upplåten med bostadsrätt, 2023 column (p8). Earlier years show a dash.

interest_cost.note: Räntekostnader och liknande resultatposter, 2023 column (p10). The prior year is -488 838.

planned_maintenance.value: underhåll/byte av tak 2025, byte av 3 balkonger 2024
planned_maintenance.note: The maintenance plan list on p6 under 'Planerade underhåll' (2024 balconies, 2025 roof). p5 says the plan runs to 2070. The NOT 6 'Planerade underhåll' note on p16 is the 2023 spend, Summa 56 546, which is a year's cost, not the plan.

auditor_remarks.value: Jag anmärker på att avgiftsuttaget inte är tillräckligt för att uppfylla stadgarna
auditor_remarks.note: Anmärkning in the revisionsberättelse (p24): the fee level does not cover the stadgar requirement. The opinion on the annual accounts itself is clean (p23).
